landmarks.source_note: Direct forward frames 235/239/243 s place the four-storey pit and club building on driver LEFT, opposite the actual mapped 271 m RIGHT main stand 1154622779. F1/Tilke describes a 280 m, four-storey compound; the FIA 2025 pit plan shows 45 numbered bays and a central passage. The reconstructed 280 m garage frontage spans native 6009→115 m across zero, with ±20 m endpoint uncertainty and its front 13 m beyond the road edge. Depth, height, exact garage-front offset and roof articulation are visual estimates, not surveyed dimensions. Paving remains outside the closed pit wall. See pit-facilities-review.json.

landmarks.name: Jeddah 280 m four-storey pit and team compound
landmarks.source_note: Primary F1/Tilke description gives 280 m and four storeys. FIA 2025 pit plan shows 45 numbered bays and a central service break. Direct forward 235/239/243 s puts the glazed garage/club building LEFT and open crowd stand RIGHT. Placement is opposite the actual 271 m main-stand footprint, with ±20 m longitudinal uncertainty. Depth, floor heights, canopy slopes and terrace details are reconstructed estimates. The prior 554 m/right-side generic compound is removed.

landmarks.name: FIA-photo registered T27 outfield pavilion
landmarks.source_note: FIA 2025 event notes page 5 locates the T27 outfield staging area at 21°37′29.3″N, 39°06′23.7″E and photographs the actual two-level framed pavilion beside the race fence. Supplied 289–293 s shows the same pale/glazed corner context before the main-straight exit. The footprint is a reconstruction about 33 m east and 37 m north of that staging control, not an OSM building or survey. Dimensions and current glazing follow the direct visual baseline; the FIA preparation photo shows its exposed frame.

landmarks.name: Diamond Tower construction state
landmarks.state: Exposed concrete core, open floorplates and columns, partial upper formwork and tower crane; no completed glazing.
landmarks.reference: Jeddah165s wider silhouette and323s cropped close construction view.
landmarks.registration: Mapped footprint retained.300m is a coarse scene estimate from the wider view, not a measured built height.432m/93levels in stale OSM describe the planned tower and are not asserted as its observed completed state. Footprint corner ground2.41–3.24m agrees with adjacent road3.24m; use road/site datum rather than adding height to a DSM roof.

landmarks.name: The Jeddah EDITION terraced track frontage
landmarks.source: Owner identifies four storeys and a 12 m lobby volume; direct overview04/331s show tiered slabs, recessed glazing, deep roof and angled white bracing. Four visual tiers are not a measured floor section. The provisional17.2m total estimate was rejected; no unsupported height reduction is made.

landmarks.structure: Slim curved-neck paired-head road poles, staggered about 32 m apart; three larger set-back stadium banks beside the early esses, and 25 m roof-mounted banks over the pit frontage.
landmarks.confidence: High for mixed pole families; moderate for primary road-pole distribution; low for estimated 16/29 m heights and exact tower stations.
